policies.name: api-service-v1
policies.description: apps/api's own identity. Every user command forwards the signed-in user's token, so this client only reads the directory the identity adapter builds grants from (PractitionerRole, AccessPolicy) and facility names (Organization). It reads no patient data and writes nothing.

policies.name: system-worker-v1
policies.description: apps/worker. Only the resource types its jobs touch: worklist Tasks (P12) to start with. No job reads Medplum today; a job that needs another type adds it here in the same PR, with a policy test.
